title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
title_zh: 无反馈自演化如何重塑智能体技能：一项系统研究
abstract_en: Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback. Such rewriting could adapt a skill to the model that uses it or erode the expert knowledge that makes it useful, yet how skills evolve under this feedback-free self-evolution has not been studied. We let models rewrite expert skills round after round without any task, run or judgment and run agents built on the same models with the rewritten skills. Our experiments show that the skills lose value rather than improve, as every model we test performs worse with them on every benchmark, by 15 points on average on SkillsBench after thirty rounds. Sampling each model's prior with skills it writes from the topic alone, we find that rewriting pulls skills toward this prior and gives up first the knowledge outside it. Putting this knowledge back recovers much of the lost pass rate, so an expert's skill is valuable largely for what the model does not write on its own. Building on this insight, SkillDiff marks this knowledge in place and raises the pass rate on SkillsBench by 4.8 points on average without feedback or any change to the skill's text. Project repository: https://github.com/LitaoGuo/How-Self-Evolution-Reshapes-Skills.
abstract_zh: 智能体技能是记录专家程序性知识的文档，模型越来越多地在没有反馈的情况下通过改写来维护它们。研究让模型在不执行任务、不试运行、不接受评判的条件下反复改写专家技能，再用基于同一模型的智能体评估改写后的技能。结果显示，所有受测模型在所有受测基准上的表现均下降；经过 30 轮改写后，SkillsBench 通过率平均下降 15 个百分点。研究以模型仅凭主题自行编写的技能来估计其先验，发现反复改写使技能向模型先验靠拢，最先流失的是模型原本不会自行写出的专家知识。补回这些知识可挽回相当一部分通过率损失。基于这一发现，SkillDiff 在不引入反馈、不改动技能正文的情况下原位标记这类知识，使 SkillsBench 通过率平均提高 4.8 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 实验将技能改写与任务评估分离：模型在改写阶段不执行任务，也不接收结果反馈；评估则使用基于同一模型的智能体。
所有受测模型在各项受测基准上均出现性能下降；30 轮改写后，SkillsBench 通过率平均下降 15 个百分点。
仅凭主题生成的技能可用于估计模型先验。反复改写优先丢失先验之外的专家知识，而补回这些知识可挽回相当一部分性能损失。
SkillDiff 无需反馈或改写技能正文，仅原位标记模型不会自行写出的知识，就使 SkillsBench 通过率平均提高 4.8 个百分点。
